referencePolicy: OSM source tags first. Independent Esri aerial used for individual plan/open-roof review only. Missing vertical and support dimensions are estimates. No Google imagery measurements and no reference imagery in git.

limitations: Aerial plans cannot establish clearance, support location or missing height. Those remain explicit estimates.
OSM level/layer tags are not silently converted into surveyed elevation.
Scalloped/curved facade canopy details may remain simplified despite retaining the exact mapped plan.
